fields.Name: Skip ICF - Conference Attendance by Year
fields.Description: ICF Annual Conference registrations by year and attendance status from MJ_BizApps_Orders: Event Order Lines. Ported from "Event Attendance by Quarter" (ICF has one annual conference, so the grain is year).

InputDefinition.userMessage: What are the attendance trends for our annual conference by year? Show registrations split into attended, no-show and cancelled as a stacked bar chart. I want to click a year and status to see the people. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a stacked bar chart by year (2019-2026) split by attendance status
Uses Event Order Lines (AttendanceStatus) for the Conference Registration product
Attended is the largest status each year and grows from about 82 (2019) to about 402 (2026)
Shows the no-show rate or otherwise makes the attended vs no-show comparison easy
Clicking a year/status shows the registrants (name, ticket tier, status)
Rows can open the underlying person or registration record
